centre.reprime_invitation: Today, the center you are working with is the Emotional: letting what arises be felt without evaluating it, without correcting it. Emotion is neither right nor wrong — it simply is.

dynamique_ego.passion_explication: An anger at imperfection — in the world, in others, in oneself. It is rarely explosive. It gets swallowed, turning into resentment, tension, over-control.
dynamique_ego.compulsion_evitement: Avoiding error, excess, imperfection at all costs.
dynamique_ego.desir_de_base: Being good, upright, of integrity — and feeling it.

essence.qualite_phrase: You don't have to become good — you already are, at the deepest level. All that remains is to feel it.
horizons: Letting imperfection be, without correcting it
Seeing perfection as already present, not something to build

intentions_du_matin: Leave one thing imperfect — without correcting it
Recognize the anger rising without swallowing it back
Be gentle with myself before being fair to the world
Choose the pleasure of an ordinary thing
Give my rigor a little room to play
Welcome a mistake without condemning it
Suspend the inner judge for an hour
pratiques_du_matin: Before noon, welcome a small failure without fixing it.
When the inner critic wakes up, tell it gently: 'thank you, it's alright.'
One activity just for pleasure — with no assessment afterward.
Drink a tea and savor it. Without improving your posture, without refining the gesture.
Feel an emotion that isn't held-back anger. Let it circulate.
Trust someone close to you to do things their own way, even if it isn't yours.

zones.description: Accepting serenity. You see perfection as already present, not something to manufacture. Reality touches you without outraging you. Your ideals serve the living.
You hold your principles, but they don't hold you. The 'must' speaks, you feel it, you can choose whether or not to listen.
The inner critic drives. You judge everything, you swallow your anger, resentment builds. Rigidity settles in.
Total self-condemnation, intolerance, even obsessive collapse. A very heavy day that calls for gentleness, not a fight.

details_riso.texte: Serene, accepting, wise. Perfection reveals itself already there — you are the expression of what is right, without imposing it.
Rational, balanced, of integrity. Your ideals serve reality, not the reverse. You see imperfection without suffering over it.
A teacher, fair, orderly without rigidity. You carry living principles.
Idealistic, dutiful. The 'must' speaks loudly. You struggle to do things right.
Critical, perfectionistic, demanding. Anger becomes resentment. The superego weighs heavy.
Condescending, austere, intolerant. You judge everything, yourself first.
Compulsive explosion. Contained anger does damage. Asking for help is vital here.

passions.label: I was hard on myself
passions.detail: Harder than I would be with a friend.

passions.label: I wanted to correct something that didn't need correcting
The world seemed imperfect to me, in need of repair
I felt alone in my principles
passions.detail: No one sees what I see.

pieges.label: I said 'we should' instead of 'I would like'
I judged an emotion as 'not proper'
pieges.detail: It just wanted to pass through.

pieges.label: I tensed up instead of opening

moments.label: I left something imperfect, in peace
I welcomed a compliment without dissecting it
Laughter passed through me without control
Something wobbly felt alive to me
I recognized a beauty in disorder
Perfection revealed itself as already present, not something to attain
I felt good without having proved anything

evenements_a_relire.label: I lost my temper in silence
I criticized someone in my head
I gently spoke my true thought
I let go of some control
I felt an emotion without judging it

remedes.label: Trust — in the course of things

matin: The morning begins. Is there one thing you could let be?
A day opens — which demand could you soften?
What do you want to welcome, rather than correct?
midi: You are in the middle of the day. What do you truly feel?
Here you are. What anger is brewing, that deserves to be named?
A possible pause. What do you want to let go of?
soir: The day is fading. What can remain unresolved?
You can simply arrive, without evaluating anything.
The evening is gentle. An imperfect note is just fine.
nuit: The night watches. One single thing to set down, then sleep.
You are still here. That is already a great deal.
